Advocate for the Respondent : PP, ASSAM  BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MRIDUL KUMAR KALITA  ORDER 17.11.2023 Heard Mr. S. Das, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Mr. B.B. Gogoi, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam.

This application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Sri Paritosh Biswas, who is Page No.# 2/2 apprehending his arrest in connection with Tamulpur PS Case No. 209/2023 under Section 354A/354D/376/506 of the Indian Penal Code.

The gist of accusation in this case is that on 22.08.2023, the victim/informant has lodged an FIR before the Officer-In-Charge of Nagrijuli Police Out-Post, under Tamulpur Police Station, inter-alia,
alleging that the petitioner, who is her father-in-law molested her on 18.08.2023, when there was no Paritosh Biswas vs The State Of Assam on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/79023852/
1 one else in the residence.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the allegation levelled in the petition against the petitioner is not true and he is ready to co- operate.
On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has produced the case diary of Tamulpur PS Case No. 209/2023 and has vehemently objected the grant of anticipatory bail to the present petitioner on the ground that there are sufficient incriminating materials against the present petitioner in the case diary.
I have considered the submissions made by learned counsel for both the sides and has gone through the materials available on record including the case diary of Tamulpur PS Case No. 209/2023.
Considering the nature of offence involved in this case as well as considering the fact that there are sufficient incriminating materials against the present petitioner in the case diary
